about: Upcoming urology congresses. Every date, venue and URL is checked against the official congress or society site before it is added - never written from memory. Edit this file to update every installed app (see docs/CONFERENCES.md), and bump updatedAt when you do.

conferences.name: AAU 2026
conferences.fullName: Arab Association of Urology Annual Congress
conferences.notes: The regional flagship, hosted in Jeddah this year. Closest major congress for Gulf/MENA trainees — the AAU also runs an oncology summit separately. Society site: araburology.org.

conferences.name: WCET 2026
conferences.notes: The endourology and uro-technology meeting — stones, laser, robotics and minimally invasive surgery. Society site listed; a dedicated congress URL is usually published closer to the date.

conferences.name: SIU 2026
conferences.fullName: 46th Congress of the Société Internationale d'Urologie
conferences.notes: The global society congress with a strong international and education focus. Note it overlaps closely with WCET 2026 in the same week.

conferences.name: EAU 2027
conferences.fullName: 42nd Annual Congress of the European Association of Urology
conferences.notes: Europe's largest urology meeting, at the RAI Amsterdam. The EAU guidelines used throughout this app are presented and updated around this congress.

conferences.name: AUA 2027
conferences.fullName: 122nd Annual Meeting of the American Urological Association
conferences.notes: The largest global urology meeting. The AUA guidelines used throughout this app are released and amended here.
